muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /events sse(Feed(ctx, send))" -}}{{- with .Event "update" -}}{{- end -}}{{- .Result -}}{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type Server struct{}

// Feed relies on the template's default event name for most events and
// overrides it for one record: template setters apply first, call-site
// options after, so the Go-side option wins.
func (Server) Feed(_ context.Context, send func(msg string, opts ...SSEEventOption) error) {
	_ = send("a")
	_ = send("b", WithEvent("delete"))
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/events", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	body := rec.Body.String()
	if want := "event: update\ndata: a\n\n"; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want the template default %q", body, want)
	}
	if want := "event: delete\ndata: b\n\n"; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
		t.Errorf("body = %q, want the overridden event %q", body, want)
	}
}
